"''He's coming back!|B2EMO playing with the girl|}} A [[human]] '''kid''' that resided on the agricultural [[planet]] [[Mina-Rau]].{{Databank|mina-rau-general-store|Mina-Rau General Store}} They had dark skin, [[color|brown]] [[eye]]s and brown [[hair]]. In [[4 BBY]], they attended at least one communal gathering between local [[farmer]]s and [[Technician|mechanics]] on Mina-Rau. While some ate at a long table, they played with [[B2EMO]]; chasing him around while holding a toy [[bowcaster]]. They later joined the others at the table, where they played with a [[All Terrain Scout Transport|AT-ST]] [[AT-ST puppet|puppet]] next to [[Bix Caleen]]. During the gathering, they wore a tan [[Clothing|dress]] over a white shirt with brown shoes and a white [[helmet]]. ==Behind the scenes== The kid appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' released in [[2025]]. They were portrayed by [[Ava McCarthy]]. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Harvest}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/andor-craft-at-st-puppet|text=Fight the Empire with an ''Andor''-Inspired AT-ST Puppet}} *{{Databank|at-st-puppet|AT-ST puppet}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი AT-ST-იანი ბავშვი }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
